profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon, a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, WA. AWS reported revenue of $716,924,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, as disclosed in a 10-K filing under ticker AMZN (CIK 0001018724). The company's website for this profile centers on Amazon SageMaker, which AWS describes as a unified environment for data, analytics, and AI development.

Amazon SageMaker is tracked as a cloud AI and ML lifecycle platform. The site describes it as bringing together model development, generative AI, data processing, and SQL analytics within a single environment called SageMaker Unified Studio. Noted capabilities include distributed training, inference, AI ops, governance, observability, and tools such as HyperPod, JumpStart, and MLOps. The platform incorporates Amazon Q Developer, described on the site as a generative AI assistant for software development, to help users discover data, build and train models, and generate SQL queries through natural language. AWS also tracks AWS Bedrock as a separate managed foundation model API service, with features including IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and AgentCore for agent orchestration.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Amazon Web Services.
